notes.title: Aisling Trading Cards coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/steamworks_docs/english/overview.png[/img]

[h3]We have some exciting news to share with you today. We are thrilled to announce that Aisling and the Tavern of Elve will soon feature Steam Trading Cards!

Whether you're a trading card collector or simply a owner of the game, this new feature adds an exciting new layer and value to your game.

We know many of you have been eagerly waiting for this update. So be sure to follow us on Steam and stay tuned for more exciting announcements and surprises!

[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1444360/Aisling_and_the_Tavern_of_Elves/
